vision.name: Black Mischievous Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Whenever your opponent draws 1 or more cards during combat, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck and you may raise a player's anger 1 level.
POWER: Banish the top card of your opponent's discard pile. Discard a card at random from your opponent's hand. Your opponent's next attack this combat gains "Draw a card."
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip sits below the art (read from a crop of the original); DR (alternate-art tier) number printed
